title: When using Notification I don't need to be nagged about cookies because I don't live in the EU
body:
**What?**
- on home page before you sign in https://notifier.cdssandbox.xyz/
- There is a banner that says 'Notify uses cookies to make the site simpler. Find out more about cookies'
- I want it cut

**Why?**
- EU law says you have to tell people what you use cookies for and I don't want to care about that. People can go look it up on the cookies page here https://notifier.cdssandbox.xyz/cookies
author: Participant 1

comments.author: Participant 2
